content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for JPU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for JPU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest/Part-Time Faculty posts at Jai Prakash University is scheduled for 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any specific reporting times.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Guest/Part-Time Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Master's Degree with a minimum of 55% marks in the relevant subject from a recognized University or Institute. Specific details for each post are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Guest/Part-Time Faculty posts at JPU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Guest/Part-Time Faculty positions across different colleges under Jai Prakash University. These include BCA, BBA, and B.Sc. Biotechnology specializations.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for the JPU Guest/Part-Time Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for the JPU Guest/Part-Time Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application for these posts is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview for JPU Recruitment 2026 be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the JPU office in Chapra, Bihar. The exact address and reporting time will be detailed in the official notification. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates carry for the JPU walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including their ID proof, educational certificates, and any experience certificates. They should also bring one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Guest/Part-Time Faculty posts at JPU?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest/Part-Time Faculty positions at Jai Prakash University primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their academic qualifications and performance during the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Bihar apply for these JPU posts?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. However, candidates should ensure they meet the eligibility criteria and are able to attend the walk-in interview in Chapra, Bihar on the specified date.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Jai Prakash University?
faq.answer: The official website of Jai Prakash University is www.jpv.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and to access the official recruitment notification.
